description: Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations - Order made under Sec. 2 of the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act No. 21 of 2003
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice that establishes a new regulatory framework. It contains an order under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003, determining that disputes relating to the possession or ownership of land shall be subject to mediation. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create a legal determination rather than announcing a personnel change or describing portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about establishing a legal/regulatory framework for dispute resolution.
